title: mm configuration: targets
description: Public connection facts for remote targets; clients pin them.
$comment: The value of top-level 'targets', for .config/mm/targets.yaml. Generated from MmConfig; run ./scripts/generate-artifacts.sh. Do not edit.

Delivery.description: How a target's hosts get a commit's files.

oneOf.description: Each host fetches the commit from the origin in its host policy.

mm sends the commit's tracked files; the hosts never contact the
git server.

Ipv4Cidr.description: An IPv4 network in CIDR notation, such as 10.90.0.0/24.

interface.description:
Use this existing private interface (`eth1`) instead of creating a
WireGuard mesh. Every node then declares its `private-address`.

mtu.description:
The mesh interface's MTU: the underlay's MTU minus 80 bytes of
WireGuard overhead. Default `1420`, which fits a 1500-byte underlay.

port.description:
The UDP port WireGuard listens on, on every node. It must be reachable
between the nodes. Default `51820`.

subnet.description: The WireGuard mesh's address range. Default `10.90.0.0/24`.

PlacementSpec.description: One placement word, or a list of them.

key.description: `ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment`; keep the private half offline.

RepoClusterConfig.description: How the nodes of a cluster target work together. Every key has a default.

groups.description: Names for sets of nodes, for a service's `placement`.

ingress.description:
The nodes that run the ingress proxy and take the traffic of every
`ingress:` route, written like a `placement`: a node, a group,
`all`, or a list. Unset means the first node.

mesh.description:
The private network between the nodes: a WireGuard mesh mm creates
(`subnet`, `port`, `mtu`) or an existing `interface`.

networks.description:
Address space for networks that span the nodes: a private range, a
/20 or larger, that no node uses for anything else. Each network
takes a /20 of it (16 nodes, room for 253 containers on each), so
the default holds 256 networks.

storage.description: The node that serves shared volumes. Unset means the first node.

public-key.description: Its public half, as added to the git host.

secret.description:
The age secret holding the private key (`mm target setup deploy-key`
creates it).

RepoTargetConfig.description:
A repo target takes one of two forms. The flat form names one host. The
cluster form lists `nodes` instead; `mm target setup` prepares them and
`mm target setup record` writes each node's keys and address back.

cluster.description: Cluster form: the nodes' private network, storage node, and groups.

delivery.description:
How the target's hosts get a commit's files. `push`: mm sends them
over its own connection and the hosts never contact the git server.
Default `fetch`: each host fetches from the origin.

host.description: Flat form: the host mm connects to.

host-key.description: The host's SSH public key, `<type> <base64>`; its fingerprint is derived.

nodes.description:
Cluster form: every node. Replaces `host`, `host-key`, and
`daemon-fingerprint`.

providers.description:
Where this target's hosts read an external secret provider, by the
provider's name under `providers:`. The hosts resolve the secrets
themselves; see `mmd secrets connect`.

setup.description: Cluster form: what setup installs on every node.

RepoTargetNode.description:
One host of a cluster target. `mm target setup record` fills `host-key`,
`daemon-fingerprint`, and `private-address`.

endpoint.description:
The address the other nodes send WireGuard packets to, when that is
not `host`: for example an address on a network the nodes share.

host.description: The public address or DNS name mm connects to.

name.description: The node's name and hostname: a lowercase hostname label.

private-address.description:
The node's address on the private network. Unset, mm assigns the
lowest free address of the mesh subnet.

RepoTargetSetup.description: What setup installs on every node of a cluster target.

break-glass.description: Recovery keys that are admin on every node.

deploy-key.description: The environment's read-only deploy key, shared by every node.

origin.description:
Git URL every node fetches the project from. Left out with
`delivery: push`, where the nodes fetch nothing.

origin-host-key.description: The git server's SSH host key, `<type> <base64>`; required for SSH origins.

user.description: The account setup connects as; the operator's mm key is authorized for it.

TargetProviderConfig.description: What a target changes about one of the project's `providers:`.

address.description:
Where this target's hosts reach the store, for example
`https://127.0.0.1:8200` when it runs on the host itself, or a mesh
address. Replaces the provider's own `address` on this target.
